prompts.guide: Edit reference image into one polished standalone game UI button sprite. Preserve the cream rounded square button base and transparent outside. Redraw the golden yellow LIGHTBULB with a complete beautifully smooth symmetrical pear-shaped outline, naturally tapered neck, and a neatly joined dark warm brown screw base with two clean rounded horizontal bands and a rounded bottom contact. No chips, broken edges, torn neck or gaps. One elegant cream curved highlight entirely inside the glass, subtle soft warm yellow gouache color variation, restrained picture-book brush strokes, flat 2D, not realistic glass, no plastic 3D. Bulb centered and fully contained with comfortable margins, about 60% of button width and 80% height. Preserve warm ivory button with delicate honey rim; NO text, no counts or badges, no rays or additional props. Transparent background outside button. Make the contours crisp and continuous, readable downsampled to 114x118.
prompts.hint: Edit image1 into ONE standalone transparent UI button sprite. Keep its warm ivory rounded square button, brown circular magnifying glass tilted with handle extending lower-right, pale blue lens and restrained cream reflection. Change the DOG EXPRESSION inside the magnifying lens to clearly focused SEARCHING / inspecting clues: both small dark pupils glance toward viewer-left, small gently lowered inquisitive eyebrows, slight brow asymmetry, closed tiny gently pursed mouth rather than happy smile. Cute thoughtful attentive investigator, not angry, sad, crying or shocked. Dog face should fill the lens and remain clearly legible at 114x118. Image2 locks identity: cream rounded square face, two floppy dusty blue ears, dusty blue patch around viewer-RIGHT eye, warm brown nose and eyes, peach cheeks, simple clean continuous warm brown contours, restrained soft gouache texture. Keep front-facing head structure but eyes glance to one side; do not mirror the patch. No hats, clothing, extra paws, question marks or new objects. Complete unbroken round magnifier rim, neatly attached handle, no clipped dog face. Match the existing warm hand-painted bakery UI style, flat 2D, no heavy glossy 3D. One full button centered with small transparent margin, no text, numbers, badge, background or other icons.
